composition.camera: Fixed orthographic projection for one coherent model; native panel aspect, no full-frame shrinking; explicit fixed-target camera-roll exception only.
composition.rootOwnedLabels: Large names/readouts/formulas/term chips composed from actual top-left pixel anchors. Axis colors X#ef5a63,Y#6cce8e,Z#66b9ed with labels. No native labels; root fixed captions protected.

convention.matrix: Each row is object/input basis in upright/output coordinates; native column transform is transposed for serialization.
convention.drawingScale: A fixed2.2 rendered-world units per one logical coordinate unit is applied equally to basis glyphs, unit anchors, P, weighted paths and projections. Actual displayed point world=origin+2.2*(vObject R); State.uprightPoint is logical, not raw world distance. The dimensionless orientation matrix and normalized basisLengths remain unscaled.
convention.diagramLimits: All numbers are authored model implementation values. No hidden game-engine values. The point stays physically fixed while coordinates are re-expressed. Matrix creep is an explicitly exaggerated illustration, not a measured accumulation run.
convention.armScope: A tool/sword input → B hand intermediate → C body output reference at the fixed shoulder origin. Internal arm-named matrices export ORIENTATION only; separated joint origins are visualization. Translation is excluded from the narrated rotation-only composition.

projection.component: cos(angle); signed uprightX component of unit objectX
projection.motionUse: L01/L04 exact state recall; L02 uses separate short native turns in narration order

reflection.interpolation: none: exact two-state comparison; do not imply singular scaling is a rotation

pointPath.point: same physical[2,0,-1] visible throughout trace; no new point motion
pointPath.cursor: Gold activeContributionCursor traverses origin→1*bodyX→P. This is an editorial contribution-tracing cursor, not motion of P; it makes first contribution visible while the full red unit-basis reference stays fixed.

creep.normalization: Normalize each row separately, leaving nonzero pair dots
creep.orthonormalization: For this triangular example row Gram-Schmidt gives identity with determinant+1. Interpolated visual repair is an illustration, not a numerical algorithm animation.

anchors.format: NDJSON one row per native frame; x/y top-left native1000x700, z camera depth
anchors.screen: origin, objectXYZ, uprightXYZ, basisUnitXYZ, point, weightedXEnd, projectionFoot, nose; armOrigin/handOrigin/swordOrigin/swordTip plus bodyCXYZ/handBXYZ/toolAXYZ for articulated example. ToolY follows the blade; do not rename it Z/forward. pose-context exports15 part.<reference>.origin anchors and orientationReferences[name,parent,rowParentOrientation].
anchors.numeric: Actual objectToUpright row matrix, inverse, Gram matrix, basis lengths, three pair dots, determinant, same point in both frames, signed projection and camera pose; arm orientation composition.
anchors.visibility: inViewport only; this flag is NOT a complete depth-occlusion detector. modelPixelBounds conservatively projects the actual deformed mesh AABB corners, not an object detector or exact silhouette. Root actual moving inspection is required before drawn guides are adopted.

gizmos.body: RGB solid unit axes; X#ef5a63 Y#6cce8e Z#66b9ed; root attaches names at true unit endpoints
gizmos.upright: gray#8f969c dashed axes and gray heads; same origin, logical unit length1
gizmos.activeArc: One progressive gold arc and tangent arrow around the actual commanded uprightY or forwardZ axis only; no decorative global rings
gizmos.depth: Axis/path/projection/point guides are explicitly editorial projected overlays rendered with owner-authored Yamyam/DiagramGuideOverlay ZTestAlways/ZWriteOff. Their actual world/pixel anchors are unchanged. Aircraft/mannequin/tool meshes retain ordinary3D depth/occlusion. This fixes actualsample e3140a42d36a hiding bodyZ and the first basis contribution inside the opaque aircraft; it does not claim engine measurements or detector visibility.
